name: IWL World Championship
notes: Named as one of the IWL's own six championships in its September 2004 King of the CyberRing tournament announcement; no holder is named in the surviving record.
epitaph: The federation's own top championship, named in passing in its 2004 tournament announcement as the prize the King of the CyberRing winner had previously contended for; no holder survives on the record.

name: IWL Internet Heavyweight Championship
notes: One of the IWL's own six championships per the fed's own September 2004 tournament announcement, which names its three most recent past holders in order but gives no dates for any reign.
epitaph: One of the federation's six prestigious championships, left vacant as of September 2004 so that year's King of the CyberRing tournament winner could claim it outright.
